cron_minute.description: Minute past the hour when the cron job runs (0–59)

cron_interval_hours.description: Interval in hours between cron job executions

cron_splay_minutes.description: Allowed variance (±) in minutes for scheduling — used for documentation only in this config line

lock_file_path.description: Path to the lock file used to determine if a previous run is still active

default_config_path.description: Path to the default configuration file sourced before running fetch-crl

reload_interval_seconds.description: Reload interval in seconds passed to fetch-crl via the -r option
